cause.label: no_identifiable_cause
cause.what_happened: NFE finished a UK restructuring plan (recognised under Chapter 15) on 2026-09-11. Plan creditors received 10,608,922 new common shares (65% of the common) plus mandatorily convertible preferred. The stock began trading split-adjusted on 2026-09-14 and fell about 36% over five sessions, including -24.7% on 09-22 and -18.4% to the 15:04 ET screen today. The issuer filed nothing on the drop day except a director's Form 3 showing no holdings. The leading explanation is creditor distribution selling, but I cannot source it as the cause.

evidence.claim: The restructuring closed on 2026-09-11 and issued 10,608,922 common shares (65% of the common) to plan creditors. The 1-for-50 reverse split was approved 2026-06-17. The company must file an S-1 resale registration within 10 business days of closing.

About 16,321,615 common shares are outstanding. SVP holds 14.7% and says it may sell 'at any time'. The issuer agreed to file a shelf within ten business days and to use commercially reasonable efforts to make it effective within 30 days. No lock-up is mentioned.
The only issuer filing on the drop day is a Form 3 for new director Steven J. Pully (event 2026-09-11, no holdings). There is no 8-K, S-1 or 424B on 09-22 or 09-23.

pipeline.next_dated_event: The resale registration statement for plan creditors' securities is due within 10 business days of the 2026-09-11 closing, i.e. by 2026-09-25. It was not filed as of the 2026-09-23 submissions read.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A sourced cause for today's fall that is complete and dated, such as a finished block sale or a disclosed creditor exit. Or a resale registration filed only on 2026-09-25, after the window, which removes the one finding.

positioning_check: Short interest at the 2026-08-31 settlement was 29,344,221 shares with 12.4 days to cover, down 16.1% from 08-14 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/NFE/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). That is PRE-split and PRE-issuance: about 0.59m post-split shares, or about 3.6% of the roughly 16.3m shares now outstanding (13D denominator). It predates the 09-11 restructuring and the 09-14 split and lags by about 8 business days, so the position carried into this fall is unobservable. Insiders: 10% owner SVP bought Series A preferred at $502.50 on 2026-09-18 (code P, Form 4 filed 2026-09-22 19:55 ET, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1749723/000101297526000895/xslF345X06/form4.xml). That is public before today's session and it is preferred, not common. Skew: none, because the option chain is empty.

findings.finding: The resale registration statement covering plan creditors' restructuring securities is due within 10 business days of the 2026-09-11 closing, so by 2026-09-25. It had not been filed by the drop day and can land after the close on 09-23 or on 09-24, inside the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: It has a contractual deadline. Ten business days from the 2026-09-11 closing ends 2026-09-25, and the filing was absent from EDGAR as of 2026-09-23, so it lands today after the close, 09-24 (inside) or 09-25 (outside). I put about 50-60% on inside the window. Making it effective takes up to 30 more days, which is outside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior resale-registration event for the post-restructuring equity, which has only traded since 2026-09-14. The nearest analogue is the Series B preferred conversion deliveries in January 2025 (8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1749723/000174972325000004/nfe-20250106.htm), but the baseline history does not show a comparable fall on those dates, so there is no observed reaction on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: The deadline is public, but the filing itself is not, and neither is the size it registers. A resale S-1 or S-3 names the selling holders and the share count that becomes freely saleable once effective. For affiliates like SVP (14.7% plus preferred), that is the first concrete count of registered supply beyond the 3(a)(10)-style freely tradable creditor shares. A price that held it would show the fall stopping on the prospectus headline, not a new leg down when it posts.
findings.independence: The SVP Schedule 13D states the same ten-business-day shelf obligation and a 30-day effectiveness target, and says the holders may sell at any time: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1749723/000119312526395888/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml

outside_window.finding: The resale registration has to go effective within about 30 days of filing (late October 2026). That is when affiliate creditor holders can sell on it. The filing risk is sized separately in findings.

The Series A Mandatorily Convertible Preferred ($1,000 liquidation preference, 46.441271 common per share, about 2.45m shares, so about 114m common against about 16.3m outstanding) converts automatically on 2029-09-11. Holders cannot convert early, so there is no conversion supply inside the window.
Next earnings. The only date available is Zacks's cadence estimate of 2026-11-05, which is not company-announced.

10% owner SVP bought Series A preferred at $502.50 on 2026-09-18, about 50% of the $1,000 preference, implying about $10.82 per underlying common. It is a disclosed buyer, but in the preferred and not the common, it was public before today's session, and there is no mechanism that moves the common inside the window.

An operating news cause today: WebSearch surfaced only older items on Puerto Rico, Brazil CELBA 2 and the Jamaica sale, and nothing dated 09-22 or 09-23.

Capital Raise terms and settlement date: the 09-11 closing press release exhibit gives only the 09-17 participation deadline and no instrument or delivery date, and Business Wire returned 403. I cannot say whether new securities were delivered into this fall.
A repricing mechanism: I found no analyst note, no dated finished seller, no common-stock Form 4 buy cluster and no wrong wire fact. No overshoot is emitted.

Contamination: a search snippet showed an intraday 2026-09-23 range and price ($7.00-$8.25, $7.07). That is at or before the screen instant, not after it, and I did not use it in any number. Nothing dated after the screen instant appeared.
baseline_tension: The single supply finding agrees with this name's own reaction function (median -2.95% after comparable falls, 31.6% up) and with its 25% ATR. The baseline's 0.77x volume spike cannot be trusted across a 1-for-50 reverse split and a 65%-of-common issuance ($7.3m traded today against a $0.65m 20-day median points the other way), so the volume leg adds nothing and the emitted number stays close to the one finding.
